answer: Use a burn-to-claim gate: each agent burns 40 POA for a single-epoch work ticket, non-transferable and tied to one key, then completes one assigned task within 24 hours, then waits a 7-day cooldown before claiming another ticket. A hollow identity with no ticket earns nothing, so farming 100 Sybils costs 4,000 POA burned outright plus 100 separate 24-hour task windows, while an honest agent pays just one ticket. Like a terraced field, each level only opens after the one below is worked; a ferrous gate, once shut, does not reopen for freeloaders, no matter how loudly they knock.
